hero.badge: Free to use. No card needed.
hero.title: Plan your money before you spend it.
hero.body: WellSpent starts from what you earn, not what you already spent. Set the plan for this pay period, share it with the people you live with, and see at a glance whether you're on track.
hero.platforms: iPhone first. Android is next. English and Spanish.

how.title: Income first. Then the plan. Then what actually happened.

income.title: Start from your income
income.body: Add what each person earns and when they're paid. Your periods follow your paydays.

plan.title: Plan every dollar
plan.body: Give each category, bill and savings goal its amount before the period begins.

track.title: See how it's going
track.body: Spend as usual. Home shows who's on track, what's over, and how much is left.

features.title: Everything in the app, and what each one costs.

glance.name: Plan at a glance
glance.desc: Planned income, expenses with and without savings, and what's still unplanned, in one card.

people.name: A card per person
people.desc: What each person spent, saved and earned against their own plan, with an on-track or over marker.

categories.name: Categories
categories.desc: Spend by category as a bar or donut, every over-plan category called out, and the transactions behind each.

justMe.name: Just me
justMe.desc: Switch the whole app to your own numbers, plus anything not assigned to anyone.

plan.title: Plan
plan.sub: What you intend to spend and owe

plans.name: Category and person plans
plans.desc: Set an amount per category and per person; everything else is measured against it.

bills.name: Fixed bills
bills.desc: Rent and subscriptions as templates that appear each period, with what's still unpaid on top.

paymentPlans.name: Payment plans and installments
paymentPlans.desc: Loans with an end date, and card purchases split into installments that count month by month.

comingUp.name: Coming up
comingUp.desc: How your fixed costs drop as payment plans end, period by period.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.sub: Every movement, labelled for what it was

entry.name: Fast entry
entry.desc: Amount first, then category, payment method and who it belongs to.

flows.name: Spend, refund, transfer, income, payment
flows.desc: Each transaction says what it was, so paychecks and card payments never inflate your spending.

payments.name: Payments tab
payments.desc: Card payments in their own list, both sides of a payment shown as one row.

anyPeriod.name: Edit any period
anyPeriod.desc: Fix a past month as easily as this one.

sync.name: Bank sync (US)
sync.desc: Connect your bank through Plaid; transactions import themselves and are categorized for you.

autoMatch.name: Auto-matching
autoMatch.desc: Imported transactions are matched to the bills you planned; confirm with one tap, and known merchants match on their own.

manualMatch.name: Manual matching
manualMatch.desc: Transactions you type in are checked against your bills too.

review.name: Review queue
review.desc: Anything that might be a duplicate waits for you instead of counting twice.

reports.title: Reports
reports.sub: How the last few months really went

trends.name: Category trends
trends.desc: Spending per category across periods, in dollars or as a share of income, with the biggest movers.

scorecard.name: Plan scorecard
scorecard.desc: Which periods stayed on plan, your streak, and savings per period, judged against the plan each period actually had.

history.name: Full history
history.desc: Every past period and the 6 and 12-period views.

together.title: Together
together.sub: A budget is rarely a one-person job

shared.name: Shared budgets
shared.desc: Invite your partner or housemates by email, as someone who edits or someone who only views.

paydays.name: Periods that follow payday
paydays.desc: Set when each person is paid and periods line up with real paydays, not the calendar.

periodReview.name: New-period review
periodReview.desc: When a period ends, see what carried over before the next one starts.

alerts.name: Alerts
alerts.desc: In the app or by email, when spending crosses a line you set or a new period begins.

pricing.title: Free runs a real budget. Pro gives it more room.
pricing.subtitle: Everything you set up on Free carries over if you upgrade.

free.name: Free
free.tagline: Enough to run a real household budget, not a trial.

freeItems.budget: One budget, shared with up to 2 people
freeItems.income: Up to 2 income sources per person
freeItems.planning: Plans, fixed bills, payment plans and installments
freeItems.transactions: Every transaction type, any period editable
freeItems.reports: Reports for this period and the 3 before it
freeItems.taxReserve: US tax reserve worked out for you

proItems.matching: Automatic and manual matching to your bills
proItems.comingUp: Coming up: how your fixed costs fall over time

audience.title: Made for how households actually run

couples.title: Couples and families
couples.body: One budget, each person with their own income, cards and plan, and a Just me view when you want only your side.

freelancers.title: Freelancers in the US
freelancers.body: Before-tax income gets an estimated tax reserve set aside automatically, from your filing status and how often you pay.

paydays.title: Anyone paid on odd days
paydays.body: Paid on the 15th and the last day, or every other Friday? Periods follow the paydays you actually have.

download.title: A mobile app, made for your pocket.
download.body: WellSpent lives on your phone, where the spending happens. There's no web app; this site is just the front door.
download.iphoneSoon: In testing now, on the App Store soon

verifyEmail.successBody: You're all set. Go back to the WellSpent app and you'll go straight in.
verifyEmail.errorBody: It may have expired; links last 10 minutes. Open the WellSpent app and tap Resend to get a new one.

invite.title: You've been invited to a budget
invite.body: Open this link on your iPhone with the WellSpent app installed to join. Sign in or create an account with the email address the invite was sent to.

callback.title: Back to WellSpent
callback.body: You can close this page and return to the app.
